title: Interpretation Graph — Session Context
description: The explicit, user-provided context a future matching engine would read. Not implemented anywhere in the running product as of this pilot — no route, no component, and no persistence layer constructs this shape today. Defines the boundary a future engine must respect: no hidden profiling, no inferred/diagnosed signals, no persistent storage implied by this schema alone.

topic.description: An explicit topic hint the user selected (e.g. 'career'), matching the existing product's QuestionForm topic-hint concept — not inferred from free text.

goal.description: ID into ontology/user-goals.json, explicitly selected by the user.

source.description: Fixed to the one currently-implemented origin. A future 'user-confirmed' origin (e.g. a follow-up question the user answers yes/no to) is allowed by confidence below but has no producing UI in this pilot.

confidence.description: No 'inferred' or 'diagnosed' value exists in this enum, by design — the engine may never guess a signal on the user's behalf.
